---
name: compare-visual-system
description: Compare hero geometry and component styling with documented reference designs.
---

Use DIFF-002 and 006. Check viewport, reference identity, provenance, usage rights and comparable component roles. Exclude the page itself and its prior scans unless the owner explicitly requested a regression comparison. Name the dimensions or tokens that match. Geometry cannot identify a builder or establish copying. Confirm intentional design-system conventions with the owner.
